notes:
Short summary: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood as primary embeddings + semantic search backend. They started with Hosted API to move fast — liked latency and SDKs, but conversation shifted to Dedicated after seeing batch upsert limits on existing vector DB. Key asks: 1) sustained QPS 150-300 for hybrid tenant workloads; 2) nightly batch jobs: upsert 2M vectors within 6 hours (delta + full refresh flow); 3) connectors: want proven integration with Postgres -> vector store and S3-based batched ingests; 4) fallback/routing: prefer hosted for dev, dedicated for production; 5) security: SOC2 + SSO + audit logs + KMS; 6) residency: US only for now.

CRM-style notes:
- "Liked streaming embeddings upload via SDK — "we can push incremental jobs without blocking""
- "AE Morgan: price sensitivity around committed capacity vs on-demand burst"
- "SE Anita: runbook requested for vector DB failover + fallback to smaller model"
- POC scope: compare Redwood Dedicated (quantized 8-bit model variant) + local vector index vs current Pinecone setup; measure end-to-end serps and rerank times.
- Internal stakeholders: Head of Search (Eva Martinez), CTO (Ravi Kaur), Prod Eng (team of 6), Data Eng (two contractors working on ETL).
- Quote from Eva (on 2/17): "We need nightly refresh to finish before business hours — otherwise search freshness is useless. If embed refresh blocks search we have to roll back."
- Decision criteria: performance (99th pct latency), cost per 1k queries, ease of integration with Snowflake/S3, SLAs for dedicated pools, proof of KMS integration.

POC specifics:
- Test dataset: 1.8M vectors derived from product events + help center docs (128-512 dim).
- Query mix: 80% read QPS, 20% write/upsert bursts during batch window.
- Metrics tracked: upsert throughput (v/s), 99p latency, cold-start first-token latency for reranking model, cost per 10k tokens + per 10k embedding calls.

Open actions:
- Provide Dedicated capacity pricing tiers with example ARR math (AE).
- Deliver SOC2 artifact and KMS integration notes (SE).
- Run 72h dedicated POC (metrics tracked + nightly batch upsert test) — schedule for week of 2026-03-15.

Short blockers: infosec wants encryption at rest with customer-managed keys; product team wants a Canary rollback plan for embedding regressions.

Contact cadence: weekly on Wednesdays.
